name: sched_get_priority_min
description: The sched_get_priority_min() function returns the minimum priority value that can be used with the scheduling algorithm identified by the specified policy. Supported policies include SCHED_FIFO, SCHED_RR, SCHED_OTHER, and others as detailed in sched(7).

parameters.name: policy
parameters.description: The scheduling policy for which to retrieve the minimum priority, such as SCHED_FIFO or SCHED_RR.

return_value.success: Returns the minimum priority value for the specified scheduling policy.
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error.

errors.description: The argument policy does not identify a defined scheduling policy.
